common.deleteBody: It will disappear from the storefront.

fields.keyHint: A short English name such as best-sellers. Used in the page address.
fields.title: Title
fields.subtitle: Subtitle
fields.imageAltHint: Read aloud to visitors who cannot see the image.
fields.urlHint: A path on this site such as /products, or a full https:// address.
fields.publishAtHint: Leave empty to publish immediately. With a future date, the item appears on its own at that time.
fields.slugHint: The part after the site address, in English: about, shipping-policy.
fields.label: Label
fields.name: Name

sections.heading: Home page sections
sections.description: The home page is these sections, top to bottom. Only visible, published sections appear.
sections.typeHint: The info strip shows the hours, address and phone from Site settings. The price list, gallery and reviews sections show what their own tabs hold.

banners.heading: Banners
banners.description: A banner shows while it is enabled and inside its dates.

pages.heading: Pages
pages.description: About, contact, policies and other text pages. A draft is not visible to visitors.
pages.previewHint: Opens the storefront showing drafts. The link works for 30 minutes.

navigation.heading: Menus
navigation.description: Header and footer links. Links to unpublished pages are hidden automatically.

settings.heading: Site settings
settings.description: Name, search defaults, contact details, booking, map, reviews and social links.
settings.titleTemplateHint: %s is replaced by the page's own title.
settings.freeShippingHint: Shown to shoppers only. The actual shipping price is set on the shipping option.
settings.openingHoursHint: One row per line, written: days | hours. For example: Sunday–Thursday | 09:00–20:00. A line without | is shown as a note.
settings.bookingUrlHint: Where every "Book an appointment" button leads. A full address starting with https://.
settings.mapEmbedUrlHint: In Google Maps: Share → Embed a map → Copy HTML, and paste it here. Only the map's address is kept.
settings.mapLinkUrlHint: Opens the location in a maps app. In Google Maps: Share → Copy link.
settings.googleReviewsUrlHint: The page that lists all the reviews of the business.
settings.googleRatingHint: The overall score from 1 to 5, for example 4.9.

brands.heading: Brands
brands.description: Brands appear as a filter in the catalog and on product pages.

seo.description: Leave empty to use the name and description.

activity.heading: Activity log
activity.description: Changes to site content, brands and admin accounts.

services.heading: Price list
services.description: Services and prices, in groups. A group appears on the site once it is published; a service can be hidden on its own.
services.noItems: No services in this group yet.
services.noteHint: A line under the group's title. Optional.
services.descriptionHint: One short line under the name. Optional.
services.priceHint: Whole shekels, VAT included. Leave empty to show only the price note.
services.priceNoteHint: Shown before the price ("from") or instead of it ("by quote"). Optional.

gallery.heading: Gallery
gallery.description: The photos of the gallery page. Photos marked for the home page also appear there. Only published photos are shown.
gallery.caption: Caption
gallery.captionHint: A short line shown with the photo. Optional.

team.heading: Team
team.description: The barbers shown on the gallery page, each with a link to their Instagram.
team.instagramHint: The full address of the profile, starting with https://.

reviews.heading: Reviews
reviews.description: Reviews are copied in by hand, exactly as the customer wrote them. The overall score and the link to all reviews are in Site settings.
reviews.dateLabelHint: Free text such as "a month ago". Optional.
